newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt's SAIB to pay out $1.10 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's SAIB to pay out $1.10 dividend.

text.p: Egypt's Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque (SAIB) said on Sunday shareholders would receive an annual dividend of $1.10 a share for the calendar year 1996.
The bank said in an announcement its general assembly has also decided to raise issued capital to $42 million from $28 million by offering shareholders one share for each two shares.
The shareholders will pay the nominal value of $10, plus a premium of $2 and an issue fee of $0.20. The stock last traded on the stock market on June 3 at $19.50.
"If the issue is not covered, which is unlikely, the unsold shares will be offered to bank employees," a bank source said.
SAIB also decided to raise its authorised capital to $100 million from $45 million.
